pages.text: Pocket peeks out of the backpack. The river sparkles in the morning sun. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
Toot, toot! Pocket rides the CityCat ferry. The aqua water swishes and swooshes, and the wind tickles one bent ear.
Up above, the great Story Bridge stretches across the river. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
Splash, splash, splash! The lagoon at South Bank is shallow and cool, with sand like a real beach. Pocket watches the sparkles.
Purple jacaranda flowers drift down, soft as feathers. One lands on Pocket's ear. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
Tip-toe, tip-toe, tip-toe. Three white ibis birds strut past the bench on their long, thin legs.
At the sanctuary, a koala hugs a gum tree. He is very, very sleepy, and he does not move at all.
Hop, hop, hop! Four kangaroos bounce across the grass. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
A tall Queenslander house stands on its stilts, with a red roof and a wide, cool porch. The sky turns orange and pink.
The sky turns lilac, and the city lights come on, one by one. "Hello, Brisbane," says Pocket. Look and look.
The lights twinkle on the river. Pocket yawns a big, slow yawn. One ear droops. Then the other.
Pocket is tucked up in the hotel room, fast asleep. Goodnight, Pocket. Goodnight, Brisbane.
